method: Source-file census with heuristic extraction of identifiers/actions/fields, plus manual README, schema, command, view and adapter review. Identifiers are not copied implementations. Runtime-generated commands and third-party tool behavior require semantic acceptance review; this is not proof of behavioral parity.

review_notes: Configurable log channel buffering maps to S01/S02; shellPod host mounts to A01; OCI architectures to D13.
Numeric plugin input preservation, bool defaults and key-conflict errors map to U03/U04.
Custom-jump viewer chaining maps to U06; explicit namespace retention to C01/B03; editor argument quoting to S03/M02.

Remaining changes include rendering/performance fixes, scanner/dependency updates, themes, tests and documentation; their owning families remain in the inventory. Unreleased behavior is not called a stable feature.
